alpha1.name: Sensitive Clone Proliferation Rate
alpha1.reference: Gatenby RA, et al. Adaptive Therapy. Cancer Res 2009; PMID: 19487300
alpha1.description: Intrinsic proliferation rate of drug-sensitive tumor clone under nutrient-abundant microenvironmental conditions.

alpha2.name: Resistant Clone Proliferation Rate
alpha2.reference: Silva AS, Gatenby RA. Biol Direct 2010; PMID: 20406443; Enriquez-Navas PM, et al. Sci Transl Med 2016; PMID: 26912903
alpha2.description: Proliferation rate of treatment-resistant clone, reflecting an evolutionary fitness cost penalty (alpha2 < alpha1).

K.name: TME Carrying Capacity
K.reference: Michor F, et al. Dynamics of cancer progression. Nat Rev Cancer 2004; PMID: 14993901
K.description: Asymptotic tumor microenvironment carrying capacity bounded by vascular perfusion limits.

ES.name: Sensitive Drug Efficacy Coefficient
ES.reference: Garnett MJ, et al. Systematic identification of genomic markers. Nature 2012; PMID: 22460902
ES.description: Pharmacodynamic cytotoxic kill coefficient targeting the sensitive subpopulation.

ER.name: Resistant Drug Efficacy Coefficient
ER.reference: Engelman JA, et al. MET amplification in lung cancer. Science 2007; PMID: 17463250
ER.description: Residual cytotoxic kill coefficient against resistant clones under bypass pathway activity.

ke.name: Drug Elimination Rate Constant
ke.reference: Brown et al. Clinical Pharmacokinetics 2016; PMID: 27481896
ke.description: Single-compartment intravenous pharmacokinetics plasma clearance rate constant.

beta.name: Toxicity Accumulation Coefficient
beta.description: Rate of cumulative systemic toxicity induction per unit of active drug concentration.

gamma.name: Toxicity Recovery Rate Constant
gamma.reference: Lancet Oncology AE recovery dynamics 2014; PMID: 24862024
gamma.description: Physiological tissue recovery and side-effect resolution clearance rate.

aSR.name: Interspecific Competition: Resistant on Sensitive
aSR.reference: Gatenby RA, et al. Adaptive Therapy. Cancer Res 2009; PMID: 19487300
aSR.description: Lotka-Volterra cross-competition coefficient representing inhibitory suppression exerted by resistant cells on sensitive cells.

aRS.name: Interspecific Competition: Sensitive on Resistant
aRS.reference: Gatenby RA, et al. Adaptive Therapy. Cancer Res 2009; PMID: 19487300
aRS.description: Lotka-Volterra cross-competition coefficient representing inhibitory suppression exerted by sensitive cells on resistant cells.
